Source: [tests.yml](../../../../.github/workflows/tests.yml).

#191 adds four manual inputs for an optional current CPK/Secrets digest pair and
common producer revision. PR/push select source-built defaults. Quoted environment
values enter the shared closed selector before Docker inspection/acquisition.
After the unchanged fixed Hello/gateway input qualification, the same preloader
pulls the two exact role references on the same Linux/amd64 daemon and checks
repository digest, source label and numeric user. Their observations never enter
the fixed helper's closed tuple. Existing package-read login, sole test.sh step,
concurrency and30-minute budget remain. No alternate workflow is introduced.

The eventual dispatch packet must bind exact producer/gate sources, independent
cohort/recipe equivalence, private destinations/digests and reviewed effects.
Source-only CI does not execute or qualify the optional pair. See
[current-root artifacts](../../../current-root-artifacts.md).

The existing authenticated host step owns exact-reference acquisition. It retains
registry allowlists, required fixed entries, optional A/B/gateway inputs, explicit
Linux/amd64 selection and RepoDigest checks. It records only whitelisted image
identity/platform/user/entrypoint/source-label/Descriptor observations in its own
temporary directory, checking the daemon is unchanged across acquisition.

#191 replaces the untyped ID equality with the actual stdlib
`qualify_preloaded_images` caller via the existing policy Python image. The
verifier receives readonly source/metadata mounts, `--network none`, no socket
and no registry credentials. Fixed optional overlaps cannot bypass linked proof;
true extras keep their prior metadata contract without invented fixed-config
qualification. The bounded report separates config and execution identities.

The temporary directory is unique to this step and removed on exit; shared images
remain retained. The next step remains the unmodified owning `./test.sh`.
No separate test runner, registry client, environment matrix, publication or
implicit runtime acceptance was added. Source review does not claim CI execution.
# Tests workflow and retained connector mode

Ordinary push, PR and manual invocations retain the existing Docker suite and
root/wrapper input selection. The default-false retained_managed_connector input
selects a mutually exclusive job only for workflow_dispatch. That job rejects
simultaneous root/wrapper requests before checkout/login/effects, then composes
the reviewed orchestration with the fixed historical cc1 owner. The existing
contents:read/packages:read permissions are unchanged.

The fixed mode's concurrency group is separate and does not cancel in-progress
qualification; ordinary runs retain their original group and cancellation
behavior. No triggers were added. This uses the already registered workflow at a
reviewed execution ref rather than requiring a new workflow on the default
branch. Only bounded result.json is uploaded for 30 days. No dispatch has been
performed as part of source validation.
